NONE: › a mark with no particular shape that is caused, usually by accident, by rubbing something such as ink or a dirty finger across a surface
› If ink, paint, etc. smudges or if someone smudges it, it becomes dirty or not clear because someone or something has touched it.
（墨跡、畫作等）被弄髒，被弄模糊；把…弄髒

example: Her hands were covered in dust and she had a black smudge on her nose.
她的手上沾滿了灰塵，鼻子上也有黑漆漆的一塊。
figurative She said we were nearly there, but the island was still no more than a distant smudge on the horizon.
她說我們快到了，但那個島依然只是地平線上遙遠的一個小黑點。
She was crying and her mascara had smudged.
她正在哭，睫毛膏都哭花了。
The signature was smudged and impossible to decipher.
簽名被弄得模糊一片，無法辨認。

NONE: › too pleased or satisfied about something you have achieved or something you know
沾沾自喜的，自鳴得意的

example: a smug grin
洋洋得意的笑
She deserved her promotion, but I wish she wasn't so smug about it.
她應該得到晉升，但我希望她對此不要那麽沾沾自喜。
There was a hint of smug self-satisfaction in her voice.
她的言語中流露出一絲自鳴得意。
He's been unbearably smug since he gave up smoking.
他戒煙之後，那個得意的樣子簡直讓人難以忍受。

NONE: C2 to take things or people to or from a place secretly and often illegally

example: She was caught trying to smuggle 26 kilos of heroin out of/into the country.
她在企圖把兩萬六千克的海洛因走私出境／入境時被抓獲。
They managed to smuggle a video of the captive journalists out of the prison.
他們設法把被俘記者的錄影帶偷偷帶出監獄。

NONE: › in a way that shows too much satisfaction or confidence
沾沾自喜地，自鳴得意地

example: "I own three cars and two boats," he said smugly.
「我有三輛汽車和兩艘船，」他自鳴得意地說。

U: › [ U ] disapproving magazines, books, pictures, filmsor jokes that offend some people because they relate to sex
（雜誌、圖書、圖片、電影等）淫穢作品，淫穢話語

C or U: › [ C or U ] dirt or ash (= powder left when something has burned) that makes a mark on something

example: There's an awful lot of smut on television these days.
如今的電視裡充斥了大量淫穢畫面。
I was really embarrassed by his smutty jokes.
他那些下流的笑話讓我感到十分尷尬。
